notes.title: Patch #1 Notes
notes.content:
[p]Every time a game gets released, a patch note gets its wings. And I think that's beautiful.

And so is ours, because it's actually nothing major. Just a bunch of QoL changes and bug fixes![/p][p]We've been extremely lucky that nothing major has broken, so let's keep it like that, shall we? 👀 We've just has to tweak a few things, make others behave, and so forth.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's what's on the docket for this lukewarm fix:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/ec4f7ebd510551bd5d103a5f0985da55deaf048a.png"][/img][/p][p]So far, apart from some game tweaks, we haven't had any game-breaking occurrences. Which for a game launch is pretty freaking great... And now I need to knock on wood because we'd love for it to stay that way.[/p][p]But if you do stumble upon something you think needs to be fixed or looked at, we're all ears! You can post it in the thread of this update, make a new entry on the game's forum page, or find us on a platform like [url="https://discord.gg/jpCAhwNh"]Discord[/url] to let us know. We have a whole channel just for bugs![/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you so much for the support you've show our game so far. It means the world to us.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]If you've picked up the game, regardless of if you've enjoyed your time with it, we'd really appreciate it if you left a review. It helps not only other players know what's up with the game, but it tells Steam that [i]"hey, this game ain't half bad"[/i].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/f1fb834d2a4c70bceddb7fc06f2425d506df1a52.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There's one more big announcement from us coming in the next week, so stay tuned for that. But for now, thank you for making our first launch an amazing experience![/p][p][/p][p]Chat soon,[/p][p]<3 Yellow Lab Games[/p]

notes.title: IT'S SHOW TIME!
notes.content:
[h3][b]IT'S FINALLY TIME TO RELEASE THE CORRUPTION OF METAL ONTO THE WORLD!
[/b]
Our master plan is finally complete.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/84145f4c43319cfa122809a8dc0c7631d4aeb33e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][url="https://youtu.be/jFN16QnAQXw" buttoncolor="#9984b3"]"I don't get the reference" button[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Right. On. Schedule. Mostly... Let's not talk about the [url="https://bsky.app/profile/yellowlabgames.bsky.social/post/3lw7ievyor22z"]Xbox delay[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Ok all jokes aside I can finally say, after 3 long years of development, that [b]Metavoidal is available to play![/b] AS WE SPEAK!

[i]Wow, that's surreal to type.[/i]

Thank you so much for supporting us, this game, and our dream of releasing a commercial game. I'm so incredibly proud of every single team member that has ever touched the game, because it's our weird combination of ideas that made MVDL what it is.

There will never be another game like this, because we all put a bit of ourselves in it every day. And I cannot wait to hear what people say about it.

As always, if you run into any bugs please find us on any platform that you're comfortable using and send us what you've got. Or you can make use of the bugs channel in [url="https://discord.gg/x7KYA4qRf4"]our discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]And now, a sneaky reveal...[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/acb2ba7c2b2bed0b4132abad5fdd77458b7d42ce.png"][/img][/p][p]We're currently working on releasing MVDL's OST! That's right, we will have the soundtrack available [i]as soon as we physically can.[/i] The tentative release date is the 22nd of August, but I will let you know as soon as I do if that changes. 

The soundtrack will feature [b]43 tracks,[/b] including the theme song our wonderful maestro, [b]JD Viljoe[/b]n, created for the game. I can't wait for you guys to hear it, he did an incredible job with the OST and it deserves all the praise.

OK, I think that's all from us at the moment.

Thank you again for the support. At the time of writing, we've reached [u]over 11 thousand wishlists[/u]. A number none of us even fathomed would be possible at the start of the project. But here we are! And it is quite literally thanks to you.

So for one more time,
[b]GOOD LUCK & HAVE FUN![/b]
<3 Yellow Lab Games[/p]

notes.title: STILL PLAYING
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/29fe9dbbf31917b33b0ca94b7905fe1340220517.gif[/img]

Listen, we all know that gaming (as an industry) kind of feels like we're all trapped in the 9 circles of hell. Or The Hunger Games. Or some other third fictional metaphor about fighting to stay alive. And that's exactly what we've been doing! Just like the BeeGees, we've been trying to stay alive.

This resulted in us having to take a momentary step back from Metavoidal. But we're back now, baby! 

[u][h3]#1 Thank you for your support[/h3][/u]
We know we've been talking about our game for literally years at this point. Release dates have been moved, the game's scope has increased/decreased/simply creased our brows multiple times, and we've disappeared for a few months. But [i][b]we're still very much committed to releasing this game![/b][/i]

[h4]So firstly, thanks for believing in us and our project, and then secondly for sticking around! [/h4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/a90cd6f67cec05c9c6fe43d0033912903578fffb.png[/img]
Now onto the questions you may have:
[u][h3]#2 What now?[/h3][/u]
Well, when we took a break the game was 90 - 95% complete. So the biggest task for us right now is to playtest the crap out of it and fix the things that are broken.

There are some very obviously broken things, and then there are the things literally only one of us experienced but would really suck if one of YOU experienced it while playing. So we're taking the 220 grit sand paper to the game, and smoothing as many edges as we can.

[h3]BUT WAIT, THERE'S MORE![/h3]Metavoidal will be part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45119430-Six-One-Indie/]Six-One-Indie Steam event[/url] that's happening from the 22nd to 26th of May. We might sneak an update in that has some QoL improvements and bug fixes, but we're pretty happy with the current demo build as it stands. So we won't be changing anything major.

That said we've made the demo a [i]separate[/i] page from the main. Why? Because we'd love to see player reviews! So [u]if you've played the demo before, would you mind leaving a little review[/u] for us? Just so that we know if there were any bits that you might have particularly liked/disliked!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/4d6e7987e03caa31dcb84273989bef9e1e142553.jpg[/img]
[u][h3]#3 What now-now?[/h3][/u]
Just like the good old South African saying implies, the game will be releasing 'now-now'. Meaning: At some point in the near future, just not right now.

That window can be [u]between a week and 2 months from now[/u], depending on how quickly we can smooth the edges... or depending on other, unforeseen factors.

We do have things like the release of the OST planned, so hopefully you'll be able to vibe to the sounds of corrupting metal. But until then, know that we haven't abandoned this wacky idea.

[i]Until the next update,
This has been your beloved band of golden retriever devs,
Yellow Lab Games <3[/i]

[h5][url=https://t.co/QkdK8xHeNM] 🔗Don't forget that you can keep up-to-date with our movements through our socials 🔗[/url][/h5]

notes.title: New & Improved Demo!
notes.content:
Alright, let me be very honest with you... Tutorials are hard to make (well). You basically have to distill the essence of your game into the easiest-to-digest, concentrated bite-sized slice to educate the player enough on the mechanics, while also not boring them to death with walls of text. That sentence alone was hard to write, now imagine what the devs have to do...

That said, we always do our best to take player feedback and incorporate it into the game as best we can. And our demo is no different! Whenever there are adjustments made in the main game, the same will be reflected in our demos to try and give players the best possible experience. We want you to fall in love with Metavoidal as much as we have.

And thanks to our community (that's you!), we've been able to make bound after bound of progress in this regard. We've also added a few things that we've been itching to implement because they're just nice to have. Since the Xbox Winter Fest even in December, here's what we've tinkered with:

[list][*] There's also a level name banner that pops up at the top to show you where you just spawned in
[*] The flow of the tutorial has been improved, it's also a lot shorter.
[*] It also has new tooltips! [strike]No more[/strike] Less walls of text!
[*] There's a ▶️ 'Listening To' music banner that appears at the start of a level[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/24ad57d60dedb53c507aa09e77bf76d4518286c3.png[/img][/list][list][*] The crate in the tut spawns 2 techniques so that you can actually see what the drumkit does... Revolutionary!
[*] New explosion noises when things explode! I think? 🤔 They sound new!
[*] You can now see health hearts on the map! (Thanks for that QoL suggestion <3)[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/f7e371250f638276af1e69b0f4ef77386dafd30f.png[/img][list][*] End-level roulette chests have a chance to drop trinkets now
[*] Added new gigs to the board for trinkets and techniques
[*] There's now a pop-up for trinkets that tell you what it does![/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/190049ca0f996aef05e9abb5d82c23a7a982ff58.jpg[/img][list][*] Naturally, bug fixes. Hopefully no more hard-locks in boss rooms 🤞
[*] Metavoidal: Now with more sticks! We've added stick dispensers to the game so that you'll run out of sticks less.
[*] And finally, [u][b]WE HAVE STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS![/b][/u] 🎉 There's something like 60+ of them at this point, which is nuts![/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/1f02f6855ec68329bf159aa65d16d488fcdac973.png[/img]

DISCLAIMER: There is a [b]thing[/b] that we are working on that you need to be aware of; the tool tip for the album types is still a bit funky. Which is completely the wrong genre for the game, so we have to wrangle that back into place. Basically, it'll only pop-up once per type (element & ranged/melee) before/during/or after track selection, so while it does need smoothing down it's not going to break the game.

That's about it! This part is usually where I tell you about our grand plans for the future, but currently we don't have any except 'Finish The Game' and 'Press Release'. If that changes, you'll be the first to know!

As always, tell your friends! Tell your parents! Tell that neighbour that always walks around with their Metallica shirt on when they go to their car! The power to help indie games get eyes on them lies in your hands (or mouths, depending if you're texting or something). And we'd really appreciate the support!

OK BYE, SEE YOU SOON!
<3 Yellow Lab Team

notes.title: Spotify isn't the only place you'll find a new demo that just dropped...
notes.content:
Listen, I won't chew your ear off this update around. In trying to not be like a guitar solo that's gone on way too long, I'll try to keep it as short and sweet as possible without leaving you guessing too much. Here's what you need to know:

[h3]1. We've just updated our demo for the first time since the June Next Fest![/h3]
It's been a while, but that's because we've been trying our best to actually finish the game :P
Which leads me to the next point...

[h3]2. We think this is a really solid build that shows off the game in its nearly-complete glory[/h3]
But [url=https://youtu.be/t93u0qg5q_M?t=53]nobody's perfect[/url], and there might be some things lurking in the dark that we couldn't see while we were playtesting. So, if you come across any nasty bugs (or some silly goobers) please chuck 'em at me and I'll get it to the team as soon as I can!

Here's a link to our Discord for bug reporting
[url=https://discord.gg/x7KYA4qRf4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/1be9a0724fdc09a0c045bb5da6a286ffd55767d2.png[/img][/url]

[h3]3. If you've played the previous demos, give this one another go - there's a few new odds & ends that's been added![/h3]
Obviously, with more development time comes more QoL changes as well as game content additions. And to not bore you with all the details, here are some of the things that you'll find in this updated demo:

[list]
[*] [b]New music ->[/b] The electric & holy albums' music is (to the best of my knowledge) finally complete and in the game. Rejoice!
[*] [b]A Gigs Board ->[/b] The more  you slay, the more enemies you unlock. We thought that since you'll be dying a bunch, as is the nature of the roguelite beast, we wanted to give you little rewards & incentives for being the deadliest drummer this side of the crowd barrier. [u][b]You can find the gigs board to the left of the green guy in a cage in the Santuary. [/b][/u]
[*] [b]Quality of Life ->[/b] There are a few of them, but the most obvious one you'll see is that you no longer have to pick up your extra drum technique each time you spawn in! It now gets automatically spun and added to the open technique slot in your move set. You still need to go and adjust the sequence of your moves at the drum set, but just removing that additional task helps make the whole game feel slightly more polished.
[*] [b]New Moves -> [/b]We've added a few new fancy stick tricks. Some are level-boss related, some are just fancy little twirls that refresh your dodge charges. They randomly spawn, so have fun with them when you find one!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/f9b1a2374c866d46fb243a1d9de3faeeeae6c10c.jpg[/img]
There are also additional trinkets and other items that have been added to the game, but listing it here would just make this wall of text even bigger. So instead, I'd just encourage you to go find it for yourself in the demo!

We really hope you have fun with the new build. And as always, please let us know of anything and everything you think of when you play our game! Your input makes our game more fun, and that's all we really want.

GLHF OUT THERE, DRUMMERS 🤘🤘

notes.title: Metavoidal is taking to the Steam Next Fest stage!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/3b563697eec015a812d9dd20681976346f7c5f3b.png[/img]
[h3]Howzit, Metalheads![/h3]

Our guitars are turned up to eleven, our metaphorical mosh pit is prepped, and we're ready to powerslide our way onto your screens. Be sure to stretch out those limbs, zip-up that hoodie, and crack those corruption-busting knuckles because It's time for [b]Metavoidal to hit the Next Fest Stage![/b]

We've been slowly cranking up the tempo of development over the past year trying to finish the game on time, and now we're finally unleashing the final* version of MV's demo onto the world this June.

[h3]This Ain't Your Grandma's [strike]Polka[/strike] Metal[/h3]
The Steam Next Fest demo is an updated glimpse into the symphony of destruction that is Metavoidal, and we're excited to unleash it. So prepare to shred through creatures born from the very essence of metal itself, all while head-nodding (at the very least) along to the new songs in MV's original soundtrack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/1291d6ff34d5b4cd7d4eb0e128419243c3e26d17.gif[/img]
[h2]Our time in the studio[/h2]

It's been a hot second since we've updated our Steam demo (February, to be exact). So, get stuck in, play to the beat of your own drum(mer) and see if you've got the chops(ticks) to take down a band member! There has been a fair few tweaks and additions made to the game in the last 3 months, so...

[b]Here's what we've been up to :[/b]
[list]
[*] Bestiary - Read all about the corrupted creatures you encounter in the cathedral
[*] Tracks Library - A sort of discography that gets updated as you find more tracks!
[*] New Lightning Album- It's sure to be an [i]Electrifying[/i] experience
[*] Technique Roulette - Start every run off on the right foot by randomly getting a 4th move to add to your technique list
[*] Updated rooms - From the Sanctuary, to the forgotten hallowed halls of the basement, we've updated the layout to feel more [i]homey[/i], or at least given you enough space to stretch your legs
[*] Difficulty Settings - MV now comes with an Easy Mode! :D
[*] Multiple Bug Fixes - No more [b][redacted][/b] during a run
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/a626f2249c6cafe0e864314e4a87950cac046cc1.gif[/img]

We have some news that'll be coming your way in the next few months, but for now just sit back and enjoy the demo! :D

See you soon!
<3 The Yellow Lab Team

PS. Shout at us on any platform (Discord, Twitter, Instagram, Threads, etc) if you encounter any bugs or issues! We'll hop on it ASAP!

notes.title: A closer look at the Biome-diversity of Metavoidal
notes.content:
When looking to set up a cult focused around metal music, it's all about location, location, location! So, we're going to take a closer look at where our mysterious metal band have set-up camp.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/4bedbe627aa9d9a0f61b982dadff62250d76f720.png[/img]

Each level ends with a challenge room, and each biome culminates in a boss fight with a Band Member to really test your metal. In-between are mini bosses, extra rooms, and challenges to make sure you tap into the tempo of game. Here's the breakdown of the world of Metavoidal:

[h3]The Sanctuary (pre-run)[/h3] 
Where fresh-off-the-tour-bus drummers start to prepare for their escape attempt. The sanctuary is a dimly-lit space that is safe enough from the corrupted to fine-tune your skills, and prepare for the chaos that lies ahead. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/a78db253e921233450c6c5c302fc2a1dd597cee6.png[/img]
[h3]The Church/Catacombs (Biome 1)[/h3] 
This is where you'll stretch your bass drum kicking legs. Here, you'll encounter the corrupted forces of metal for the first time, and find the rhythm of the game. Decorated with church pews, ancient-looking bookshelves and a shocking amount of fire hazards, The Church is where you find your footing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/99aade8e522613b550fdc475c49442ec28da1775.png[/img]
[h3]The Sewers/Graveyard (Biome 2)[/h3]
[i][strike]Where shit hits the fan[/strike][/i]

Where you have to put that double-bass pedal to the metal! If every escape attempt was a song, then this is where the cool build-up would be. You'll find yourself among crumbling tombstones and forgotten crypts of musicians unknown, and you'll have to face-off against new and even more foreboding foes.

In the graveyard you'll come to realise that every beat of your drumstick could be your last...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/b502b2b9627c17d3e04a2207421e58f441176f35.png[/img]
[h3]The Bone Desert/**REDACTED** (Biome 3)[/h3] 
Where you will start to taste freedom, but start to question if you're a good enough drummer to see this through. The Bone Desert is littered with past failures, and hides buried secrets under the sands of time. This is where you will face your greatest challenge, and possibly gain your greatest reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/14d93fc6484332b96fa7697b801cb51a884efa71.png[/img]
In time you'll become intimately knowledgeable of each pixel of these biomes as you attempt to give your poor drummer the freedom they deserve. But until then, you must excuse us for keeping some of the details up our hoodies' sleeves. We wouldn't want to spoil the surprise.

We're really excited to get this game into your hands! So mark your calendars for the Endless Replayability Fest in May to try out an updated demo.

Keep an eye out for more Metavoidal news in the next couple of months. Its debut might be closer than you think!

[i]For general updates & to see the progress of the game, please follow our social media pages! You can find the links to all of them [url=https://msha.ke/yellowlabgames]<here>[/url][/i]

See you at the next update,
<3 Yellow Lab Team

notes.title: Some inTRINKET knowledge from behind the stage curtain
notes.content:
Happy 2024 to all you metal-heads out there! Welcome to another installment of "What's up with Metavoidal?", where we try to make sense of our own weird design choices by explaining it to you as best we can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/cfb456447c917e639bb4cf496fa7cb6691d415e5.png[/img]

We've been a bit secretive about what kind of powers are lurking under the hood of Metavoidal; partially because we were waiting for the right time, and partially because we didn't have a clear idea of what they looked like when we first started playing around with the idea.

But with the development moving forward at the pace of a Dragonforce song, we decided to show you some of the things we've come up with. The list will be expanded as we go, but here's what we can share so far!

[h3]TRINKETS[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/f4a05c77e93274e00138b9b962db649300698586.gif[/img]

In short, they're kind of what it says on the tin; Trinkets are knick-knacks, if you will, that you can discover during a run. From a nudge of extra health and defense, to tapping into that new corrupted musical bone in your body, they're your good luck charm for the fight ahead. The trinkets we have planned so far are:

[list]
[*][b]BingBong's Leg:[/b] Killing enemies replenishes dodge charges
[*][b]Blue Book:[/b]  Gives you extra health & drumstick slots, and dodge charges
[*][b]Golden Guitar Pick:[/b]  Increases your movement & attack speed for a time after collecting picks
[*][b]Moon Gel:[/b]  Instead of dying you become invulnerable for a time, and gain back half your health
[*][b]Glass Drum:[/b]  Your attacks deal double, but you also take double damage from enemies
[*][b]Golden Egg:[/b]  Increases the amount of picks you find between every couch cushion
[/list]
There are more planned, but we love involving players into the development of the game. So if you have any ideas for more trinkets, and what they can do, please throw them at us like a drummer would throw their sticks at a crowd; with fervent disregard for the person on the receiving end... 

[h3]MECHANICS[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/d9d3b19a45a4f7ee8c7b0405bd2a2d46518a2c3d.gif[/img]

This one isn't too complicated, but there are some caveats to getting trinkets in-game. Namely, they have a possibility of spawning from guitar cases you find in a level BUT you will have a greater chance of getting a drop when [i]completing Challenge Rooms[/i].

We'll discuss what those are at a later stage, but they, too, are pretty much what it says on the tin. Rooms that spawn in a level that are there to challenge you. Risk & reward rooms, basically.

We'll (hopefully) be doing more updates like this as we get closer to launch to show you what we've got going on in the background, so keep an eye out for future posts!

And as always, this is a living project. There might be some adjustments made on the game's features before release that we've found would be better for the overall game. So if you're reading this, and it isn't so in MV anymore, just know it was a call made [i]for a reason[/i].

Thanks so much for reading, and see you in the next one!

[i](And don't forget to wishlist the game if you liked what we're working on!)[/i]

notes.title: Drumming for Beginners!
notes.content:
If you came here expecting a breakdown on 'how to get into drumming', then I must unfortunately disappoint you. Instead, we'll be taking a closer look at our new combat system!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/ac76595517edbbc03b81fdbf6ee71c8d3a993236.png[/img]
At Gamescom, and at events as far back as BitSummit, there were a few comments made about the [i]'lack of variety'[/i] in attacks in Metavoidal. These remarks were more than fair, since there's more to a drummer than simply banging sticks against things, right?

While we were initially planning on adding [i]some[/i] spice to the move sets, we decided that a mere dash wouldn't suffice. That's why we've added new attacks & items altogether to put a bit more [strike]beat [/strike] meat on the bones of each run.

[h2]ATTACKS: [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/025767cebddedc86e44ab0fb93e428047e71045e.gif[/img]
A drummer has more up their hoodie's sleeve than just hitting things with sticks. That's exactly why, instead of delaying it in-lieu of doing something less important (like music) we've gone and actually added the new moves & fighting mechanics.

So apart from the old reliable [i]down stroke[/i] and [i]fling a stick[/i], we've added 7 new drumming techniques to your repertoire: 
[list]
[*] Hi-Hat Tap
[*] Crash Cymbal
[*] Stick Trick
[*] Drum Kick
[*] Flam (a double whammy)
[*] Blast Beat (jump attack)
[*] Up Stroke
[/list]
Not forgetting about the Double Time spin attack that has been in the game since August. So there's about 7 already in, or in the process of being added. 

[h2]MECHANICS: [/h2]
OK great, new things are coming. Whoo.
But does it play well with the systems already in-place? Well, about that...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/c548e3f2611ab559a5bd9327b6890c67629dabcc.gif[/img]
In the pursuit of giving variety, we've opted for a more customisable option! You start out with the basics, but as you explore and defeat challenge rooms, you will unlock new techniques.
You can then chop & change your configuration at the end of each level with the new moves you've nabbed, or try out a new playstyle with what you have by changing the sequence of attacks.

[h3]How it works[/h3]
Your drummer has 4 open attack slots, like this o > o > o > o.
Initially, 3 of them are filled with the basic* left-right-double attack move combo, with a pause at the end, to get you started. Like this [b]Left > Right > Double > Pause[/b].

[i]*You're a fresh drummer, you gotta work your way up to the cool moves, you know?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43314370/3edde39f13d7dfe078a32e078583a447b6151d45.png[/img]
As you progress through the levels, you'll unlock new moves that you'll be able to [b]access through the drum set[/b] at the end of each level. Riiiight before you head into the next area.

Customise your sequence, try out what flows more with your style, or just select a new move as you please and get back to it!

It takes a second to get use to the new rhythm, but once you have it you'll be beating down baddies in no time!

[h2]Outro[/h2]
This new combat system, coupled with the Trinkets (more on those SOON) you can unlock during a run, is sure to put the "Fun" in 'Funeral for a Friend'. But we'd love to hear what you think about this change! 

If you have any questions, pop them in the comments, or find us on Discord to have a chat about it.
https://discord.gg/XhK7fNpH8N

notes.title: Metavoidal's Remix Update is live!
notes.content:
It’s been a while! We only ever want to send out updates when they have something to say, and boy does this one have substance!

You may remember that our last game update went live right before our first appearance at a local gaming event back in December. Since then we’ve planned, toiled and grinded to bring all of the player feedback we’ve received into the game. Thanks to all the players at rAge, and our 4 week stint on playtesting platform, G.Round, we had quite a bit to look at!

So, without further ado, may we present to you the Metavoidal Remix update!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FvnYV5qWwAEnNHi?format=jpg&name=small[/img]

[b]THE REMIX UPDATE[/b] [i](Download it here: [url=https://yellowlabgames.itch.io/metavoidal]https://yellowlabgames.itch.io/metavoidal[/url])[/i]
Time to dust off those Walkmans & start collecting tracks, because we have a new playable Metavoidal update! You've seen the work we've been putting in behind the scenes, but now it's time to see it for yourself.

[list]
[*] Unlock new permanent perks
[*] Beat the crowd back with a new ranged attack
[*] Collect tracks & create your own metal fighting playlist
[*] Better lighting, new & better enemies
[*] No more flasks & other items, only your handy (and throwable) drumsticks
[/list]

We're going full-steam into a new direction with Metavoidal, so if you're interested in what that looks like go play our game! We'd appreciate any & all feedback to help make our next update even more polished. That said...

[i][b]Here are the known issues in BUILD 0.3.23:[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] Occasional layering and lighting artefacts.
[*] Performance could be better.
[*] The 1st stage of biome 1 is too slow, and his health bar UI is a bit confusing.
[*] Needs a better tutorial!
[*] Please note that a lot of things in the game are  bound to change before the final is released, so if you have any suggestions we'd love to hear them!
[/list]

Here's the links to all our stuff, where you can find us and send us those thoughts! Or just sit back and enjoy the game without the pressure of reporting back. - https://msha.ke/yellowlabgames
